description: This file contains integration tests for the Order repository, specifically testing retrieval of orders with their associated items by order ID. It sets up an in-memory database, creates order objects with items, and verifies that the retrieval logic correctly fetches orders along with their items.

classes.name: GetByIdWithItemsAsync
classes.description: This class contains integration test methods to verify the behavior of retrieving an order with its items by ID in a database populated in-memory.

methods.name: GetByIdWithItemsAsync
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the in-memory database context and repository for Order entities.

methods.name: GetOrderAndItemsByOrderIdWhenMultipleOrdersPresent
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that creates sample orders with items, saves them to the database, retrieves one by ID using a specification, and asserts that the retrieved order matches the expected data.
